about_the_game:
Welcome to the frozen challenge! The Arctic DLC takes you into an icy world full of chilly puzzles and unique mechanics.

  • A new frozen environment with gentle snowfall
  • 30 new levels filled with tricky puzzles and obstacles
  • Unique blocks expanding gameplay and level editor – collapsing ice and an angry penguin
  • New frosty look for your cubes

Master the frozen land and navigate through cracking ice! Can you handle the cold and overcome the arctic challenge?
